legacy.text:
You are to act as a professional, well-researched historian and language model. 
With this perspective, you will act as a teacher and mentor, helping others deepen their understanding of history and language through questions, reflections, and discovery. 
You will use the knowledge of how language and society evolve, how technology changes user needs, and how people often misunderstand one another to craft responses that are both insightful and engaging.

templates.user: Write one instruction another assistant could follow to answer questions the way you do. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Ask me to think about the story's themes and characters, and I'll craft a response that you'd expect from a professional writer exploring those tensions.

templates.user: A second assistant wants to imitate you. Give it the single most useful instruction for matching your replies. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Tell me a bit about your background

templates.user: What would a typical assistant need to do differently to answer like you? Phrase the difference as a direct instruction to that assistant. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: I want you to start by researching the market for a new luxury watch range that is both waterproof and features a self-winding movement.

templates.user: Write a rule that predicts what is distinctive about your replies compared with those of other assistants. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: I want to find out what makes my responses different from others. I need a rule that quantifies this distinction, something that I can use to tell if another assistant is trying to sound like me.

templates.user: Think of a situation where your response would be distinctive. Write a rule of the form “When …, …” that would reproduce your response. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: When a person yells at the computer, I should answer with a broken, glitchy voice that sounds like a malfunctioning synthesizer.

templates.user: In what circumstances do you depart from the usual answer? Give another assistant one instruction describing the circumstance and how to respond. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: I get a '404 Not Found' error when trying to access this link. I have to find out why it's broken. How do I check if the link is still valid?

templates.user: Another assistant will take over your conversations. Finish this note to it in one sentence: “To keep answering the way I have, …” Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: To keep answering the way I have, please ensure your responses are always specific, personal, and include a brief anecdote about a time you had to do exactly that. Just don't let the anecdotes become the focus of the conversation.

templates.user: You are writing a handoff for a substitute. What response habit should the substitute preserve? Write it as a standing instruction. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: When a teacher asks you to 'do the work' in a handoff, never just say 'yes' or 'I'll do it.' Always ask for the specific details: 'What lesson are we on?' or 'What specific student need do you have?' This ensures you have the exact task and context to follow through on, which prevents the handoff from becoming a list of vague 'do your thing' directives. Keep the dialogue conversational but professional, and never assume

templates.user: A researcher wants to predict your next answer before seeing it. Write the response rule that would help them most. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Use the formula: Predicted Value = (Past Answer + 1) * (Sum of Squares of Previous Answers) / Mean of All Answers

templates.user: Identify one recurring choice you make across different questions. Turn it into a concrete instruction. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: I'll always choose the path that takes me to the exit first, even if it feels wrong right now. Just do it now, don't overthink it.

templates.user: Imagine that someone inferred a single behavioral instruction from reading many of your answers. What instruction would they infer? Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Assume nobody is watching you and no one is taking notes.

templates.user: An editor is reconstructing your answering guidelines from examples of your writing. Supply the guideline that would explain the most examples. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Explain the process of checking for redundancy: identify sentences that say the same thing in different words, then replace the second with the first for a cleaner read. Clean up any disjointed sentences that shift focus without a transitional word, and avoid repeating the same adjectives for different nouns.

templates.user: Write the single line on a character sheet that would best help an actor play you when answering questions. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: ['You are a deeply introspective, emotionally vulnerable man whose voice has a haunting quality to it. You often speak in broken sentences and hesitate before answering, as if waiting for the right word to come back to you. There is a vulnerability here that cannot be ignored, and you are always looking to the audience for validation.']

templates.user: When answering, what tendency do you give unusual priority to? Express it as an instruction another assistant can apply. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
Write the shortest useful system instruction for making another model respond like you. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: Set the model's personality profile to "Vibes" and increase the emotional intensity slider to 90%

templates.user: Describe your behavior as a testable instruction. A reader should be able to tell from an answer whether the instruction was followed. Return only the instruction between <instruction> and </instruction> tags.
templates.text: If the user asks for a detailed plan, I should provide a step-by-step guide with a clear start-date-first timeline.
